en.answer: The effects form a Chain, then resolve accordingly. Therefore, the attack target will end up being changed to the last <<9729>> to have been Summoned.
en.question: My opponent's monster declares an attack. What happens if the respective ①st effects of two copies of <<18148>> are activated in response?
en.title: What happens if the ①st effect of <<18148>> is activated twice on the same chain?

ja.answer:
その場合でもチェーン処理が行われます。
そのため、最終的には最後に特殊召喚された「<<9729>>」に攻撃対象が移し替えられます。
